items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: You remember Johnny French and Marshall, one where his trumpet plays?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, you know Johnny French. You remember Johnny French and Marshall, one where his trumpet plays? Oh, yes, yes, I do. Johnny French appreciates banjo, he's got a big choice. That's a good rap. Oh, well.
Who were the best trumpet players you ever heard, would you say? I've never heard no one, no better than E.T. Thomas.
